items.description: Tens of thousands of Israelis were evacuated from their homes near the border with Lebanon. Many of them have still not returned.

items.description: President Zelensky describes the daytime drone attack in Ukraine's capital as a "new page in Russian degradation"

items.title: Russia Says It Expects Ukraine Peace Talks to Resume as Deadly Attack Hits Kyiv
items.description: Russia says it expects trilateral talks with Ukraine and the US to resume, even as its forces launched a deadly attack on Kyiv. Peskov also welcomed US and Indian peace efforts and accused Kyiv of prolonging the war.

items.title: In Gaza, women-headed households face ‘impossible choices’ to survive
items.description: In war-torn Gaza, a growing number of women-headed households face “impossible decisions” every day, amid ongoing Israeli airstrikes and still-scarce resources, UN humanitarians said on Tuesday.

items.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia ignite fires at oil facilities and wound 73 people
items.description: The attacks come after weeks of escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, which shattered a four-year truce in the country's civil war.

items.title: Serbia Honors 'Butcher Of Bosnia' Ratko Mladic, Drawing Outrage Over Glorification
items.description: Thousands attended the Belgrade funeral for convicted war criminal Ratko Mladic, who died while serving a life sentence for genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity. items.title: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner hold Ukraine talks after meeting Putin
items.description: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv, seeking to revive efforts to end the war. But the latest diplomatic push seems to have produced no breakthrough.

items.title: Russia’s Lavrov Calls Accusations of Moscow’s Involvement in Leipzig Drone Incident ‘Start of Real War'
items.description: The German government said last week that Russia was responsible for an attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport.
